tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dkon mchog gsum dang skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dkon mchog gsum dang skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkon mchog gsum dang skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs

/ na mo gu ru mañdzu ghoṣā ya/ rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gog lam bden gnyis dngos gyur dam pa'i chos/ /rig grol tshogs gnyis dpal ldan dge 'dun la/ /gus pas btud nas de yi rnam gzhag bshad/ /de yang thar 'dod kyis skyes bus ni/ /skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gyi khyad par shes dgos te/ de ma shes par skyabs su 'gro ba ni dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mos pa tsam yin gyi/ tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes brtan po thob pa min pas so/ /de na 'dir de'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa la gnyis/ dngos dang 'phros don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ /nyan thos sde ba'i 'dod tshul bshad pa dang*/ /theg chen pa'i lugs rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bye brag smra bas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la gzugs sku dang sprul sku'i tha snyad byed kyang*/ longs sku'i rnam gzhag khas mi len pas/ mchog gi sprul sku'i tha snyad kyang*/ dngos su mi bzhed par gsal lo/ /des gzugs sku sangs rgyas su khas len kyang sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu mi 'dod de/ des de sdug bsngal bden par 'dod pas so/ /nyan thos sde gnyis kas slob pa 'phags pa rnams dge 'dun du bzhed kyang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog tu mi 'dod de/ des de dag gi rgyud kyi lam bden rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog dang 'gog bden rnams chos dkon mchog tu khas len pa'i phyir ro/ khyad par zhib par ni gzhan nas shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa theg chen po'i lugs bshad pa la gnyis/ skyabs kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga/ skyabs gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ skyabs gsum gyi ngo bo/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i skyabs kyi khyad par/ rgyu skyabs dang 'bras skyabs kyi khyad par/ sgra don no/ /dang po der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rnams ni/ gtso bor sangs rgyas dkon mchog la mos shing mchog tu bya ba byed pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/

de de rnams kyi skyabs su bzhag /gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rnams ni/ chos dkon mchog la mos shing mchog tu bya ba byed pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ de de rnams kyi skyabs su bzhag /gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams ni/ gtso bor dge 'dun dkon mchog la mos shing mchog tu bya ba byed pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ de de rnams kyi skyabs su bzhag cing*/ de lta na'ang gdul bya re res kyang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs ston pa po/ dam pa'i chos la skyabs dngos/ dge 'dun la skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs su byed par mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ston pa bstan pa slob don gyis/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum las/ /mos pa gsum gyi dbang mdzad nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa skyabs gsum gyi ngo bo bshad pa la gsum gyi dang po sangs rgyas dkon mchog la gsum/ mtshan nyid dang*/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i skyabs gnas mthar thug /sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa yin te/ rang don gyi yon tan gsum dang gzhan don gyi yon tan gsum/ khyad gzhi rang don phun tshogs kyi yon tan dang*/ gzhan don phun tshogs kyi yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa'i yon tan/ 'bad rtsol nye bar zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i yon tan/ rjod byed kyi sgra dang rtog pa'i rkyen tsam gyis ji lta ba bzhin rtogs mi nus pa'i yon tan gsum dang*/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i yon tan/ nus pa'i yon tan gsum/ dbye gzhi rang don dang gzhan don gyi yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ byams mgon gyis rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/

/gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbye na/ kun rdzob pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog gnyis/ dang po gzhan don gzugs sku dang*/ gnyis pa ni rang don chos sku la byed do/ /dang po la dbye na gnyis/ longs sku dang sprul sku'o/ /dang po ni/ longs sku de tha mal pa'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul ma yin pa phra ba ye shes kyi sku can nges pa lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ sku nges pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa/ gnas nges pa 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa/ 'khor nges pa byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gi bskor ba/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig gsung ba/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid ma stong kyi bar du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul mi ston par bzhugs pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid lnga dang yang ldan te/ sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sgo nas chos ston pa rgyun mi chad/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i sgo nas theg chen gyi chos brjod pa rgyun mi chad/ thugs snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'phrin las mdzad pa rgyun mi chad/ 'bad rtsol gyi 'du byed med pa dang*/ gdul bya'i ngo bor sprul pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i phyir te/ byams pas/ brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi chad dang*/ mngon par 'du byed med pa dang*/ de'i ngo bor mi ston pa/ 'dir ni sna tshogs snang bar brjod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dbye na gsum/ mchog gi sprul sku/ bzo bo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku'o/ /dang po ni/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sprul sku ste/ bdag cag gi ston pa lta bu'o/ /'di ni so skye'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin kyang*/ sku sha rus brdos bcas ltar snang yang de ma yin par gser gar bu bzhin te/ don la ni pho ba dang nang khrol rgyu ma sogs kyang med ces gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las rgyas par bshad pa ltar ro/

/gnyis pa ni/ bi shwa karma lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ dam pa tog dkar lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa chos sku la gnyis/ spangs pa chos sku dang*/ rtogs pa chos sku'o/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid sku ste/ 'di ni dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid kyi sku zhig la byed cing*/ dbye na gnyis/ rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku'o/ /sku de yon tan lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ gzhal du med pa'i yon tan/ grangs med pa'i yon tan/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan/ mi mnyam pa'i yon tan/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ byams pas/ gzhal med grangs med bsam med dang*/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid lnga dang yang ldan te/ rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa/ rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i tshogs pa dang ngo bo dbyer med pa/ sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis spangs pa/ sgrib pa gsum las grol ba/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha 'od gsal ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ byams pas/ 'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol ba/ /zhes pa nas/ dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa ye shes chos sku dang rnam mkhyen don gcig cing*/ 'di la der gyur pa'i ji ltar ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis sam/ me long ye shes sogs lnga dang*/ rgyas par na zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig yod/ de rnams bsdu na chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis su 'du zhing*/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum du 'ang 'du/ rgyu gang la brten nas thob pa ni/ gzugs sku gnyis gtso bor bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ chos sku gnyis gtso bor ye shes kyi tshogs las 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/

sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa ste/ /chos kyi sku de mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa chos dkon mchog la gsum/ /mtshan nyid/ yon tan/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi rnam byang bden pa/ chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa chos dkon mchog de yang yon tan brgyad dang ldan te/ 'gog bden gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan gsum dang*/ lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i yon tan gsum/ khyad par de ldan gyi 'gog pa dang lam gyi yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ rtog ge'i blos mtha' bzhir bsam du med pa/ las nyon gnyis ci rigs med pa/ tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog med pa'i yon tan gsum dang*/ rang gi ngo bo dang 'dzin stangs la sgrib pa'i slad pa ma zhugs pa'i dag pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gsal/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i yon tan gsum dang*/ gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba 'gog pa dang*/ gang gis chags pa dang bral byed lam gyi yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ byams pas/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med dang*/ dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ngo bo'i sgau nas dbye na 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gnyis/ dngos po btags ma phye bar dbye na/ kun rdzob pa'i chos dkon mchog dang*/ don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lta bu lung gi chos 'khor rnams te/ 'di dag ni chos dkon mchog btags pa ba yin gyi/ dngos ni min no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phags rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams so/ /gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ yon tan/

dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad po gang rung dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog de yon tan brgyad dang ldan te/ ji lta ba rig pa/ ji snyed pa rig pa/ so so rang rig pa gsum dang*/ chags sgrib/ thogs sgrib/ dman sgrib las grol ba gsum dang*/ khyad gzhi rig pa dang grol ba'i yon tan gnyis te brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ byams pas/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ / ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams su yod la/ sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog dang*/ don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam zhugs kyi so skye rnams te/ dge 'dun yin yang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog ni min no/ /der ma zad/ lam du ma zhugs kyang thar pa don du gnyer ba'i rab byung rnams ni dge 'dun tsam yin pa mi 'gal la/ 'dul ba las ni/ dge slong bzhi tshan du longs pa la ni/ dge 'dun dang*/ de re re la ni gang zag ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /gnyis pa don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad la bya'o/ /mdor na/ bdag med phra rags gang rung mngon sum du ma rtogs tshun chad 'phags lam thob pa med cing*/ 'phags lam thob pa dang dge 'dun dkon mchog tu gyur ba/ chos dkon mchog thob pa gsum dus mnyam mo/ /'dir bzhed pa mi 'dra ba ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po kha cig /kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog dang*/ don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog gnyis 'gal bar bzhed la/ kha cig ni/ dge 'dun dkon mchog yin na/ kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin pas khyab ces gsungs shing*/ kha cig byang sems 'phags pa rnams don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin kyang*/

theg dman 'phags pa rnams de min zhes 'dod pa dang*/ kha cig don dam pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin na/ lam bden yin pas khyab ces zer yang*/ rang lugs ni sngar ltar byas na legs te/ drin lan gsab ba'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das dge 'dun gang la skyabs su 'gro lags/ bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro yi/ kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun la ni ma yin no/ /zhes skyabs su 'gro yul gyi dge 'dun la gtso phal gyi khyad par bstan pas shes so/ /'dis ni de gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bor don dam pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro dgos par bstan gyi/ kun rdzob pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mi 'gro ba bstan pa ni min no/ /gsum pa ni/ lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin pa'i skyabs/ don dam pa'i skyabs kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gnyis don gcig lam gyi bgrod pa mthar ma phyin pa'i skyabs/ kun rdzob pa'i skyabs kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang sangs rgyas pa'i skyabs gnyis don gcig /mdor na/ slob pa 'phags pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rgyud kyi lung rtogs kyi chos rnams ni kun rdzob pa'i skyabs yin gyi/ don dam pa'i skyabs ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i skyabs ni sangs rgyas kho na yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i dkon mchog gsum ni/ rgyu skyabs dang*/ rang rgyud la 'byung 'gyur gyi dkon mchog gsum ni 'bras skyabs yin la/ gzhi gcig la bltos te/ de gnyis ni 'gal yang*/ spyir de gnyis mi 'gal te/ bdag cag gi ston pa de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir te/ de rang dang rgyud tha dad pa'i sems can gyi rgyu skyabs dang*/

rang dang rgyud gcig pa'i sems can gyi 'bras bu skyabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byang sems gyi rgyu skyabs yin na/ de'i rgyu yin pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems mthong lam pa dang dus mnyam pa'i de'i phyir yongs 'dzin de/ de'i rgyu skyabs yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'bras skyabs yin na/ de'i 'bras bu yin pas ma khyab te/ de'i rgyud kyi nang gi yongs 'dzin thabs shes khyad par can de/ de'i 'bras skyabs dang*/ de'i thob 'gyur gyi ngo bo nyid sku yang*/ de'i 'bras skyabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa sgra don ni/ byams pas rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bshad pa la drug /skyabs su 'os tshul/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo/ skyabs su 'gro tshul/ bslab bya/ phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog nyid skyabs su 'os pa yin te/ gdul bya'i don mdzad tshul shes pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ de mdzad par bzhed pa'i brtse ba dang*/ de mdzad nus pa'i nus pa gsum dang yang dag par ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ de nyid kyis bstan pa'i chos dang de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun yang skyabs su 'os so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs pa spyi dang*/ bye brag ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la yod par yid ches pa'o/ /gsum pa ngo bor bshad pa la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bzhed tshul gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs yul la rang stobs kyis dpung gnyen du re ba 'cha' ba'i sems pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa de la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ rdo rje byed tshig gi skyabs 'gro dang*/ ltos pa blo'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/

dang po ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig rnams te/ de skyabs 'gro dngos min no/ /gnyis pa dbye na gnyis/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can dang*/ phal pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkon mchog la rang stobs kyi dpung gnyen du re ba 'cha' ba'i sems pa/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i skyabs 'gro/ /'bring dang thun mong pa'i skyabs 'gro/ /skyes bu chen po'i skyabs 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bskyab pa'i phyir du dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro'o/ /gzhan yang rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ /'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis te/ dang po ni/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i dkon mchog gsum po gang rung la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyud la 'byung 'gyur gyi dkon mchog gsum po gang rung la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro ste/ skyabs 'gro de gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yang yod par mngon no/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro phal pa la gnyis/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs phal pa la rang stobs kyis dpung gnyen du re ba 'cha' ba'i sems pa/ skyabs 'gro phal pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin/ dbang phyug sogs la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro lta bu'o/ /rgyal po dang blon po sogs la re bltos 'cha' ba yod kyang*/ de skyabs 'gro phal par yang 'jog dka' ste/ de 'jog na/ pha ma dang sman pa sogs sems can dang*/ khang khyim ljon shing sogs sems can ma yin pa gzhan du ma la re bltos 'cha' ba'ang srid pas/ thams cad kyang skyabs yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po kha cig/ skyabs 'gro sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i 'jug sgo yin pas/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud la skyabs 'gro med de/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud kyi tshangs pa la re bltos 'cha' ba'i sems pa de/ skyabs 'gro phal pa yin kyang skyabs 'gro min no zhes bzhed cing*/ kha cig /dkon mchog las gzhan pa'i gang zag las skyabs su song yang*/ skyabs 'gro'i go mi chod pas/ skyabs 'gro yin na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro yin pas khyab ces gsungs la/ kha cig / 'phags pa ma yin pa'i lam zhugs la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro de/ skyabs 'gro rnams dag yin kyang*/ tshangs pa sogs la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro de/ skyabs 'gro yang min zhes zer/ kha cig /dkon mchog gsum po gang rung gcig kho na skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro yod ces gsungs shing*/ kha cig ni/ de 'dra mi srid ces bzhed pa sogs mang yang*/ rang lugs ni bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro tshul la bzhi/ yon tan shes pa/ khyad par shes pa/ khas blangs pa shes pa/ gzhan du mi smra ba shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar dkon mchog gi yon tan rnams dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyi khyad par shes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar dkon mchog gsum po so so'i mtshan nyid kyi khyad par spangs rtogs kyi khyad par/ 'phrin las kyi khyad par shes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas la skyabs ston pa po/ /chos myang 'das la skyabs dngos/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs su dam bca' ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas de nyid la skyabs su 'gro dgos kyi/ de dang mi mthun pa'i skyabs ltar snang gzhan la skyabs su mi 'gro ba'o/ /lnga pa bslab bya la gnyis/ so so'i bslab bya dang*/

thun mong gi bslab bya'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dgag pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo myang 'das las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la/ /skyabs su song ba ma yin no/ / dam pa'i chos la skyabs 'gro ba/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs pa min/ /zhes gsungs ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sku brnyan dang*/ chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig yan dang*/ rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa la'ang*/ de dag dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog cing gus par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi bslab bya bdun bcu ste/ skyes bu dam pa bsten pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ sdom pa len pa/ snying rje che ba/ dkon mchog gi yon tan dran pa/ rang gis ci nus su mchod pa/ gzhan dkon mchog mchod pa la bskul ba/ dgos pa ci 'dra ba la'ang dkon mchod cing gsol ba/ phan yon shes nas nyin lan gsum dang mtshan lan gsum du skyabs su 'gro ba/ srog gi phyir yang dkon mchog blos mi gtong ba'o/ /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya gzhan dang 'gal na nyes pa 'byung yang skyabs 'gro mi gtong la/ phyi ma 'di dang 'gal na ni skyabs 'gro gtong bas shin tu gzab par bya'o/ /drug pa phan yon ni brgyad de/ nang pa sangs rgyas par chud pa/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa/ sgrib pa dag pa/ tshogs rdzogs pa/ ngan 'gror mi ltung ba/ bar chad kyis tshugs dka' ba/ bsam pa 'grub pa/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i phan yon rnams 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'phros don ni/ spyir mdo sngags gang gi dbang du byas kyang skyabs kyi ngo bo dang*/ skyabs su 'gro tshul sogs sngar bshad pa ltar yin na'ang*/ bla med kyi skabs su sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdo lugs dang cung mi 'dra ba yod de/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i longs sku dang*/ 'dus byas yin pa'i ngo bo nyid sku yang bzhed par gsungs shing*/

sku gsum gyi tha snyad tsam ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi skabs su'ang yod do/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyang dkon mchog gsum po gang rung du 'du ba yin te/ de dag las sangs rgyas yin pa rnams ni de nyid dang*/ de min pa rnams ni dge 'dun du 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig /rje mi las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /'di gsum phyi yi skyabs 'gro yin/ /zhes dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /'di gsum nang gi skyabs 'gro yin/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ /'di gsum gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ sngags kyi skabs su phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro'i tha snyad mdzad kyang*/ de ltar byed pa ni/ rgyud rgya gzhung sogs las bshad pa zhig yod na/ rje yab sras kyis kyang gsal bar 'chad dgos na'ang*/ de mi 'dug pas 'dir btang snyoms su bya ba rigs so/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i dmigs rim dang cho ga ni/ gzhan nas shes par bya ste/ mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /smras pa/ gang dag rgyal ba'i bstan la mchog gsum por/ tshig rjes 'brang ba'i dad pa tsam min par/ /rigs pa'i rjes zhugs skyabs su 'gro 'dod na/ /skyabs kyi ngo bo khyad par shes pa gces/ tshul de mi shes bris 'bur glegs bam sogs/ /brdar btags skyabs kyi gzugs brnyan tsam zhig ni/ /de dag dngos su bzung nas skyabs song yang*/ /'ben ma mthong ba'i mun pa'i mda' 'phen bzhin/ /zhing gi dam pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /gus pas bsten cing mchod pa yal bor nas/ /dud 'gro'i khyu mang skyabs ltar rtag bsten pa'i/ / rab byung gang de bstan 'dir ji lta bu/ /rnyed pa thob na dkon mchog drin las te/ /ma thob 'gyod med gnas pa'i nus med par/ /de nyid ched du gtso bor 'bad pa khyod/ /rab tu byung ba'i dgos pa de'am ci/ zhes pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/
gzhan la phan 'dod kyi 'dun pa kho nas sbyar ba ste/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phan par gyur cig/ maṅgalaṃ// //
